EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in the Communications program at ASU!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for expressing interest in the communications master's program at Arizona State University. The Master of Arts in Communication Studies is a cutting-edge degree program designed for students who wish to prepare for communication-intensive roles in a range of fields, including public affairs, employee development, community relations and grassroots movements, as well as in organizations dealing with political and health concerns. The program provides exposure to a variety of research methods, communication theories and practical applications, with a special emphasis on advocacy. For more information about the program, feel free to review the MACS Program Handbook. https://newcollege.asu.edu/sites/default/files/files/advising/documents/macs_graduate_handbook_2015-16.pdf
Be sure to review our application checklist at this address: https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B44BICxe1BtdaVVCVlZBZExEZlE/view?usp=sharing for more information about the application process in an easy to follow format, and peruse our sample schedule here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B91ycyfLEFl7N0JBWUpzd2VpdU0/view?usp=sharing to explore the flexible curriculum available for both full-time and part-time students. Also, please take a moment to check out our new e-magazine on our site and see all the exciting work being done by our faculty and students.
It's important to find the right fit in graduate school. A great way to learn more about this degree is to register for one of our upcoming information sessions. You can view the dates on our site, then email me to RSVP for any date you plan to attend.
Kindest regards, Graduate Studies
New College of Interdisciplinary Arts and Sciences Arizona State University, West campus nc.gradstudies@asu.edu
